**A Practical Guide on Graphical Model Validation**（arXiv `2609.26445v1`）**是一篇**把**「**保**险**建模**的**模**型**验证**工具」**系**统**化**的**手册****——**逐字标题**为**「**A Practical Guide on Graphical Model Validation**」**，**作者逐字为 **`Mario V. Wüthrich`****。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**软件**包**注册处**面（**npm）＋**补**修**上轮未决的 **arXiv** 线」**。
**可核实信息（均 2026-09-25 arXiv API 实测）**：
**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它**把**「**加**权**口**径」**当**成**整**篇**的**核**心**判**断**——**⭐ 本次实测**：**摘要**逐字**写**「**Particular emphasis is placed on whether calibration and discrimination are studied under a policy-weighted or an exposure-weighted population measure. This distinction is crucial in ensuring that premium schemes are calibrated on the correct scale.**」**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**对 **RIAA** 最有用**：**⭐ 即**「**校**准**图」**与 **Gini** 这**类**指标**看**起**来**客**观**，**但**换**一**个**加**权**口**径**就**会**变**——**⭐ 按**保单**数**加**权**回**答**的**是**「**平**均**一**张**保单**」**的**问**题**，**按**暴**露**加**权**回**答**的**是**「**总**损**失**」**的**问**题**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**报**告**任**何**验**证**指标**时**，**在**表**注**里**写**明**「**分**母**是**保单**数**还**是**暴露**度」**，**否**则**读**者**会**按**自**己**的**默**认**口**径**理**解**；**⭐ 而**更**值**得**学**的**是**作**者**把**这**件**事**提**到**「**crucial」**的**地**位**——**⭐ 即**口**径**不**是**细**节**，**而**是**结**论**可**否**成**立**的**前**提**。
**⭐⭐ ② 它**给**出**一**份**可**照**抄**的**两**类**工**具**清**单****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**摘要**逐字**列**出**图**形**工具 **`calibration plots`／**`actual-vs-expected plots`／**`lift charts`／**`Murphy diagrams`**，**与**统**计**工具 **`Bregman losses`／**`deviance losses`／**`elementary losses`／**`Murphy’s decomposition`／**`Gini scores`****；**⭐ 本词条**据此**指出**：**⭐ 即**这**九**项**覆**盖**了**「**看**图**判**断」**与**「**算**数**判**断」**两**条**路**，**且**其**中 **`actual-vs-expected`** 与 **`lift chart`** 在**核**保**与**市**场**营**销**里**也**直**接**可**用**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**做**模**型**作**业**时**，**用**这**份**清**单**当**报**表**结**构**，**比**只**报 **AUC** 或 **R²** 更**贴**近**保**险**实**务**（**⭐ 与**第 **379** 轮**记下的**「**把**评**价**准**则**事**先**承**诺」**同**向）**。
**⭐⭐ ③ 它**来**自**本站**已**跟踪**的**作**者**，**而**这**提**示**了**一**种**补**充**策**略****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**作者逐字 **`Mario V. Wüthrich`****（**本站**已**有 **[[ai-in-actuarial-science]]** 与其**他**相关**条目）**；**⭐ 本词条**据此**指出**：**⭐ 即**「**按**人**跟**踪**」**（**作**者**的**新**产出）**能**抓**到**关**键**词**检**索**漏**掉**的**东**西**——**⭐ 因**为**作**者**的**新**作**品**在**刚**提**交**时**引**用**数**与**关**键**词**都**还**没**沉**淀**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**选**定**几**位**本**域**作**者**（**或**导**师）**，**定**期**看**其 **arXiv** 页**，**是**低**成本**的**信**息**源**。
**⭐⭐ ④ 它**的**元数据**形**态**也**值**得**记**（**无 **DOI**、**无**期刊**信息）****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**记录**逐字**给出 **id **`http://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26445v1`**、**published 与 **updated 均 **2026-09-22**、**作**者 **`Mario V. Wüthrich`**、**comment** 与 **`arxiv:comment`** 字**段**为**空**、**`arxiv:doi`** 与 **`arxiv:journal_ref`** 亦**为**空**；**⭐ 本词条**如实**指出**：**⭐ 即**「**预**印**本**尚**未**投**出」**与**「**投**出**了**但**系统**未**记**录」**在**元数据**上**都**表**现**为**空**——**⭐ 故**引**用**预**印**本**时**要**写**明**「**本**次**引**用**的**是 **arXiv** 预**印**本**（**截**至 **2026-09-25**）**，**未**见**同**行**评**审**版**本」**（**⭐ 与**第 **381** 轮**记下的**「**接口**字**段**不**可**全**信」**同**类，**而**这**一**次**涉**及**学**术**出**版**状态）**。
**⭐⭐ ⑤ 交付**形态**与**可**得**性****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**摘要**实测 **611** 字符**（**短**而**密**，**没**有**废**话）**，**适合**快**速**判**断**是**否**要**读**全**文**；**⭐ 本词条**如实**指出**：**⭐ 即**它**是**「**实**用**指**南」**而**不**是**新**方**法**——**⭐ 它**的**价**值**在**于**「**把**已**有**工**具**放**在**一**起**并**说**清**口**径」**，**故**读**者**不**应**期**待**新**统**计**量**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**引**用**这**类**手**册**时**，**写**「**它**是**工**具**汇**编**与**口**径**提**醒」**，**而**不**要**写**成**「**提**出**了**新**方**法」**。
**⭐⭐ ⑥ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[insurance-calibration]]、**[[rank-preserving-calibration]] 与 **[[reproducible-actuarial-work]] 覆盖**校**准**与**可**复**现**主**题**、**[[ai-in-actuarial-science]] 为**同**一**作**者的**相**关**条**目**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**把**图**形**与**统**计**两**类**验**证**工具**系**统**化**、**并**以**加**权**口**径**为**核**心**判**断」这一**形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较**。
**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 五件事值得借**：**① **校**准**与**区**分**度**要**写**明**加**权**口**径**；**② **用**九**项**工**具**清**单**当**报**表**结**构**；**③ **按**作**者**跟**踪**补**关**键**词**检**索**之**不**足**；**④ **引**用**预**印**本**要**写**明**版**本**与**评**审**状**态**；**⑤ **工**具**汇**编**类**文**章**不**要**当**成**新**方**法**引**用**。
**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有阅读**其**正文**、**未**复**现**其**任**何**图**表**或**统**计**量**，**故**不**主张**其**工**具**定**义**的**准**确**性**、**公**式**细节**或**数**值**示例**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**arXiv** 记录**接口**返回的**元数据与摘要**（**摘要**实测 **611** 字符）**，**未读**其**全文**。**③ ⚠️ **未核实**其**是**否**已**投**稿**或**发**表**（**记录**中 **`arxiv:doi`** 与 **`arxiv:journal_ref`** 均**为**空）**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其**九**项**工具**的**具**体**定**义**与**实**现**（**如 **Murphy** 分**解**的**具**体**形式）**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核实**其**是**否**附**带**代**码**或**数**据**。**⑥ ⚠️ 窗口**状况**：**提交日 **2026-09-22** 落在**本轮**窗口**之内**（**基准日 **2026-09-25）**，**故**无需**缺口**说明**。**⑦ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-25 所见**；**⚠️ 涉**及**模**型**验**证**，**⚠️ 不**构成**任何**定价**、**核保**或**审计**意见**。

e.body_en:
This manuscript systematises model validation tools for insurance modelling. **This entry belongs to the round theme of the package registry surface together with fixing the preprint surface left unresolved in an earlier round.**
**Verified information, all measured on 2026-09-25 from the preprint interface**:
**First, it makes the weighting convention the central judgement of the whole manuscript.** The abstract states that particular emphasis is placed on whether calibration and discrimination are studied under a policy-weighted or an exposure-weighted population measure, and that this distinction is crucial in ensuring that premium schemes are calibrated on the correct scale. **Metrics such as calibration plots and Gini scores look objective but change with the weighting convention: weighting by policy count answers a question about an average policy, while weighting by exposure answers a question about total loss. Any validation metric should therefore state in its caption whether the denominator is policy count or exposure, or readers will apply their own default, and the deeper lesson is that the author elevates the convention to a crucial status, meaning the convention is a precondition for the conclusion rather than a detail.**
**Second, it supplies a checklist of two families of tools that can be copied directly.** The abstract lists graphical tools, namely calibration plots, actual-versus-expected plots, lift charts, and Murphy diagrams, and statistical tools, namely Bregman losses, deviance losses, elementary losses, Murphy decomposition, and Gini scores. **Together these cover a visual route and a numeric route, and two of them are directly useful in underwriting and marketing as well, so using this list as the reporting structure for a modelling assignment is closer to insurance practice than reporting a single discrimination measure, in the same direction as the earlier note about precommitting evaluation criteria.**
**Third, it comes from an author this site already tracks, which points to a complementary discovery strategy.** Following a specific author output stream catches what keyword search misses, because a newly submitted work has not yet accumulated citations or stable keywords, and picking a few domain authors or supervisors and checking their preprint listing periodically is a low-cost information channel.**
**Fourth, the metadata shape is itself worth recording, since it carries no identifier and no journal reference.** The record gives an identifier, submission and update dates in the window, a single author, and empty fields for the author comment, the archival identifier, and the journal reference. **A preprint not yet submitted and one submitted but not recorded both appear as empty, so a citation should state that the preprint version is being used as of a given date and that no peer-reviewed version was found, a variant of the earlier rule that interface fields cannot be fully trusted, here applied to publication status.**
**Fifth, delivery shape.** The abstract runs to about six hundred characters with no filler, which suits a quick judgement about whether to read the whole text, and the artefact is a practical guide rather than a new method, so its value is gathering existing tools and clarifying conventions rather than proposing a new statistic, and citations should describe it accordingly.**
**Sixth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover calibration themes, rank-preserving calibration, reproducible actuarial work, and another work by the same author, **while this entry supplies the form of a systematised guide to graphical and statistical validation tools with weighting convention as the central judgement. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**
**For RIAA**: **five practices transfer: state the weighting convention for calibration and discrimination; use the tool checklist as a reporting structure; follow authors to complement keyword search; state the version and review status when citing a preprint; and describe a tool compilation as a compilation rather than a new method.**
**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the manuscript text was not read and none of its figures, tables, or statistics were reproduced**, so no claim is made about the accuracy of tool definitions, formula details, or numerical examples. **Second, only metadata and abstract, measured at about six hundred characters, were read**, not the full text. **Third, whether it has been submitted or published was not verified**, the archival identifier and journal reference fields being empty. **Fourth, the precise definitions and implementations of the nine tools were not verified**, for instance the specific form of the decomposition attributed to Murphy. **Fifth, whether code or data accompany it was not verified. Sixth, the submission date falls inside this round window against a baseline of the twenty-fifth of September. This distinction is crucial in ensuring that premium schemes are calibrated on the correct scale.**；**⭐ 即**按保單數加權與按暴露加權會給出不同校準圖與 Gini**，**報告時要在表注寫明分母**。
